title: Final deflection angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 60°.

title: Refractive index range
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (2) must be 2√3/3 ≤ n < 2.

title: Geometry at point D
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the angle of refraction at D as 30° using the given triangle geometry.

title: Total internal reflection at E
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the condition for total internal reflection at point E to find the minimum refractive index.

title: Geometry for incidence at F
description: Important Criteria: The student must use triangle geometry and reflection laws to find the 30° angle of incidence at point F.

title: Path tracing and deflection
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly trace the light path and sum angle changes to find the total 60° deflection.

title: Upper bound from refraction
description: Optional Criteria: The student may derive the upper bound n < 2 from Snell's law at point F to ensure refraction occurs.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points for sign errors in angle summation or incorrect units (e.g., radians vs. degrees).

title: Misapplied TIR condition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points for incorrectly applying the total internal reflection condition (e.g., using n > 1/sin(c) instead of n >= 1/sin(c)).
